pr_title: Fix aurora alert sensor always Off
pr_body:
Fix aurora integration issue #121954.
Update threshold when user changes configuration.

Threshold change was previously not acted upon
until a restart.

issue_context.title: Aurora alert sensor always Off
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Whenever visibility is greater than configured alert level, alert sensor remains off.

For instance, I have configured the alert to trigger when visibility is greater than 12%, the visibility shows 25% but the alert sensor is still showing "off" instead of "On". 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.7.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

aurora

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/aurora

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

Try to add another location in your Aurora integration, try 69.0171369, 17.2748956
it currently shows 7% in my case.
The problem seems to be that the threshold value is not propagated internally at reconfiguration. However, after a restart of HA the new threshold will be acted upon.

This does update the threshold, but doesn't update the state of the sensors.

To apply the actual change, we should trigger a refresh or reload the config entry.

About the testing, I agree that there ought to be some tests added for the binary sensor. As it is now, I can only see that there are tests for the config flow.
